objects.label: Debug Gizmos
objects.description: Displays coordinate markers (map centers, tile boundaries) for debugging purposes.

ground_snap.label: Ground Altitude Lock
ground_snap.description: Constrains the camera focus altitude to the actual terrain height while panning.

dummy_toast.label: Test Toast Notifications
dummy_toast.description: Displays sample toast notifications for UI testing.

lock_camera_tilt.label: Lock Camera Tilt Gesture
lock_camera_tilt.description: When on, drag/pinch gestures can no longer change camera tilt (polar). Rotate (azimuth) and zoom still work normally.
